sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: How many grams make up one and a half kilograms?
Which of the following English alphabet letters has both vertical and horizontal lines of symmetry?
If a squirrel can jump 3 meters in a single leap, how many jumps will it take to cover 21 meters?
How many total seconds are there in 2 minutes and 15 seconds?
If 1 centimeter on a map represents 20 kilometers on the ground, what does 4 centimeters represent?
In a pictograph, if one smiley face symbol represents 5 children, how many children do 6 smiley faces represent?
What is the perimeter of a square quilt patch if one side measures 8 cm?
A container holds exactly 3 Litres and 250 millilitres of water. How much is this in just millilitres?
If you are facing North and you take a full quarter-turn (right angle) to your right, which direction will you be facing?
A coconut vendor sells 12 coconuts every hour. How many will he sell in 5 hours?
A jug has 1 litre of fresh juice. If 300 ml is poured into a glass, how much juice is left in the jug? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: One litre equals 1000 millilitres. Subtracting 300 ml from 1000 ml leaves 700 ml. Therefore, exactly 700 ml of juice remains in the jug.

questions.question_text: A runner finishes a short race in exactly 145 seconds. How can this time be written in minutes and seconds? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: One minute has 60 seconds, so two minutes have 120 seconds. Subtracting 120 from 145 gives 25. The race time is 2 minutes and 25 seconds.

questions.question_text: How many lines of symmetry does a standard rectangle have, and what do these lines do to the shape? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A rectangle has exactly two lines of symmetry. These vertical and horizontal lines divide the shape into two perfectly equal and matching mirror halves.

questions.question_text: A coconut farmer harvests 45 coconuts from one tree. If he has 8 similar trees, what is his total harvest? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the total harvest, we multiply the number of coconuts per tree by the number of trees. Multiplying 45 by 8 gives exactly 360 coconuts.

questions.question_text: On a city map, a distance of 1 cm represents an actual distance of 15 km. What does 6 cm represent? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: If one centimeter equals 15 kilometers, we multiply 15 by 6 to find the actual distance. This means 6 centimeters on the map represents 90 kilometers.

questions.question_text: Grandmother is making a rectangular quilt that is 4 meters long and 3 meters wide. She wants to attach a beautiful lace border around the edges. What length of lace is needed? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: To find the length of lace, we must calculate the perimeter. The formula is two times the sum of length and width. Adding 4 and 3 gives 7 meters. Multiplying 7 by 2 gives 14 meters. She needs exactly 14 meters of lace.

questions.question_text: A kangaroo covers 6 meters in a single jump, while a frog covers 2 meters. How many jumps will each animal take to cross a perfectly straight 24-meter path? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: We divide the total path length by the jump distance. For the kangaroo, 24 divided by 6 equals 4 jumps. For the frog, 24 divided by 2 equals 12 jumps. The kangaroo takes far fewer jumps than the frog to cross the path.

sections.section_name: Section D - Mathematical Expression & Data Analysis

questions.question_text: A pictograph records book sales. One book symbol represents 12 books. If Monday shows 4 symbols and Tuesday shows 2 and a half symbols, calculate the total books sold over both days. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Total symbols for Monday are 4, and Tuesday has 2.5 symbols. Adding them gives 6.5 total symbols. Since each symbol equals 12 books, we multiply 6.5 by 12. Six full symbols equal 72 books, and a half symbol equals 6 books. Adding 72 and 6 gives a total of 78 books sold.

questions.question_text: A baker mixes 1 kg 500 g of flour with 800 g of sugar to bake cakes. If he divides the total mixture equally into 5 bowls, what is the exact weight of the mixture in each bowl? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, convert all weights to grams. One kilogram is 1000 grams, so the flour weighs 1500 grams. Adding 1500 grams of flour to 800 grams of sugar gives a total of 2300 grams. Dividing 2300 by 5 equal bowls means each bowl contains exactly 460 grams of the cake mixture.
